exact_git_blob_identity_rule.scheduled_chat_transport: A large full-file rendering that exposes the file body/revision but omits or truncates metadata is not by itself authority-unverifiable. Perform exactly one same-path identity-only/minimal-range Git file read, such as lines 1-2, and bind the complete response sha. If resource-backed metadata is not in the first visible rendering, read only the response-resource metadata continuation needed for that same-path sha. This is bounded transport, not semantic retry/wait/poll/backoff.

otherwise perform exactly one same-path identity-only/minimal-range fetch and bind the complete sha returned by that response

only after those bounded same-path transport surfaces fail may the path be classified authority-unverifiable
exact_git_blob_identity_rule.failure_rule: If the full same-path 40-hex blob cannot be obtained after bounded transport, fail closed, preserve nonempty exact continuation naming path/transport error, claim no bootstrap/persistence/acceptance credit, and return recurring-open without same-run wait/poll/backoff/retry.
